versions.content: When CanIf_Transmit() is called and the container CanI- fTxPduCfg->CanIfTxPduXLParams is existing which indicates a CAN XL frame, then CanXL_Write() shall be used for transmission. Otherwise Can_Write() shall be used for transmission.
